mapper.insert: insert into ai_conversation (user_id, conversation_type, title, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{conversationType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from ai_conversation where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 1
select * from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 order by update_time desc, id desc
select * from ai_conversation order by update_time desc, id desc
